name: intel-ovms-agentic-setup
description: Download and start OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) on Windows for local chat on an Intel AI PC. Use after Developer Kit verification shows OpenVINO GenAI is ready, or when the user asks to install OVMS or start local inference. Use profile verify for a small smoke model and profile agent for the large Hermes chat model. A network download needs approval. If the user asked only for OVMS, stop when it is running. Continue to the provider step only when their request includes switching Hermes. Not for installing the Developer Kit (intel-devkit-install), switching the agent provider by itself, or VS Code Continue (openvino-coding-assistant on this same port 8000 model).
